footer.tagline: Animals listed with their record — weights, feeding, lineage and lab-verified genetics.

provenance.label: Record
provenance.tooltipEmpty: The seller has not published any of this animal's record.

browse.title: Browse animals
browse.emptyBody: Try widening the price range, removing a gene, or including sold animals as price comparison.
browse.searchPlaceholderHobby: Morph, het, breeder or city: “clown”, “het pied”…
browse.emptyVisualBody: A bare gene means a visual. Tap the gene again to look for hets instead, widen the price, or save this search and check back.
browse.catalogueEmptyBody: No breeder has published an animal yet. Check back soon.

filters.title: Filters
filters.geneHet: Het required. Tap to rule out visuals.
filters.geneVisualExcluded: Visuals ruled out. Tap to clear.
filters.morphsHint: Tap once for a visual, twice for a het, three times to rule visuals out. Type “66% het hypo” or “pos het ghost” in the search box for the rest.

listing.comparables: Comparable sold: {{low}}–{{high}} · {{count}} in the last year
listing.noComparables: Not enough recent sales for a price comparison yet.
listing.reported: Thanks — our moderators will look at this listing.

reportTypes.incorrect_genetics: The genetics are wrong or overstated
reportTypes.fake_listing: The animal or photos aren't real

record.title: The record — published by the seller
record.weights: Weight history — {{from}} g to {{to}} g over {{count}} entries
record.none: This seller hasn't published any of the animal's record. You can ask them for it before buying.

store.noAvailableBody: This breeder has no animals listed at the moment. Their sold history may still be worth a look.
store.noAbout: This breeder hasn't written an about section yet.
store.noTerms: This breeder hasn't published terms yet. Ask them directly before agreeing a sale.

contact.messageDraft: Hi — is {{title}} still available? I'd love to know more.
contact.offerDraft: I'd like to make an offer for {{title}}.
contact.atOrAbove: At or above the asking price.
contact.threadNote: This opens a thread in your inbox — the seller's reply lands there.

inbox.pickBody: Messages about an animal, the offers on it, and where the deal stands all live in one thread.
inbox.blocked: Blocked. They can no longer message you.
inbox.reported: Reported. Our moderators will take a look.
inbox.reportPlaceholder: Scam attempt, abusive language, off-platform payment…
inbox.unblocked: Unblocked. You can message each other again.
inbox.youBlocked: You blocked {{name}}. Neither of you can send messages here until you unblock them.
inbox.closedThread: This conversation is closed. New messages can't be sent.
inbox.reportGoesTo: This goes to the moderators with their last message attached.

reportTypes.scam_suspicion: Scam, or asking to pay off the platform

deal.title: Where this stands
deal.acceptedToast: Offer accepted. The animal is now reserved.
deal.depositHint: Record it here if the buyer has already paid a deposit.
deal.acceptExplainer: Accepting an offer marks the animal Reserved and writes the sale record. It stays visible with a Reserved badge until you mark it collected.
deal.reviewPrompt: The sale is complete. How did it go with {{name}}?
deal.reviewed: You reviewed this sale. It shows on the breeder's store page.
deal.completeTitle: Mark this animal as handed over?
deal.completedRecordToast: Sale complete. The animal and its record are now in the buyer's account.
deal.completeRecordBody: The sale is recorded as complete and the listing shows as sold. The buyer receives the animal's record (genetics with their sources, weights, feeding, health, lineage and certificate codes) and is invited to review you. Your own copy stays, marked Sold. This can't be undone here.

sell.title: List an animal
sell.pickBody: Everything you've already logged — photos, weights, feeding, genetics, lineage — comes across with the animal. You choose what stays private in step 3.
sell.noAnimalsBody: Every animal in your collection is either already listed or filtered out. You can also list something you haven't logged yet.
sell.notFound: That listing could not be found.
sell.geneticsHint: Separate traits with commas. Anything starting with “het” renders as a het tag.
sell.descriptionPlaceholder: How she feeds, what she was produced from, how you'd like to hand her over…
sell.noAnimalTitle: This listing isn't linked to an animal
sell.noAnimalBody: It can still be published, but it can't carry weights, feeding, lineage or a lab certificate — so it will always show an empty record.

publish.title: What should buyers see?
publish.body: Every switch adds a piece of the animal's record to the listing. Nothing is shared until you publish, and you can change any of this later.
publish.previewLabel: Buyer's view — updates as you switch
publish.nothingLogged: Nothing logged for this yet — turning it on publishes nothing.
publish.strong: Full record. This is the strongest a listing can be.
publish.encourage: {{filled}} of 4 published. Listings carrying more of the record get more enquiries, because buyers can check them.
publish.showGeneticTestResultWhy: Proves a het instead of asking buyers to take your word
publish.showWeightHistoryWhy: Shows steady growth rather than a single number
publish.showFeedingHistoryWhy: The question buyers ask most often
publish.showLineageWhy: Buyers can trace the animal back through your clutches
publish.showAnimalIdWhy: Lets a buyer reference the animal by your own ID
publish.showBreederNotesWhy: Off by default — these are usually for you, not buyers

photos.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB each. The first photo is what buyers see in the grid.
photos.full: You can attach up to {{max}} photos.
photos.type: {{name}} is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.

dashboard.emptyBody: Animals you list appear here with their views, saves and offers.
dashboard.unpublishedTitle: {{title}} is carrying evidence you haven't published
dashboard.unpublishedBody: You have {{list}} on file for this animal. Publishing it strengthens the listing.
dashboard.storeBody: This is what buyers see when they open your store from a listing.

saved.title: Saved
saved.noAnimalsBody: Tap the heart on any animal to keep it here while you decide.
saved.name: Name this search
saved.searchSavedCount: Saved. Your Saved page shows how many new animals match each time you look.
saved.saveBodyCount: It goes on your Saved page, which shows how many new animals match since you last ran it.
saved.matchSummary: {{count}} match now · {{fresh}} listed since you last ran it.
saved.matchUnknown: Run it to see what matches now.
saved.noSearchesBodyCount: Set up the filters you actually want — a visual, a het, a sex, a price ceiling — and save them. This page then shows how many new animals match each time you look.

reviews.placeholder: How was the communication, the accuracy of the listing, and the animal's condition?
reviews.noneBody: Buyers can leave a review once a sale through the marketplace is completed.
reviews.nonePendingBody: Once a purchase through the marketplace is completed, you can review the breeder here.

gate.browsingIsFree: Browsing, filtering and opening any listing stay free — no account needed.
gate.favoriteTitle: Sign in to save this animal
gate.favoriteBody: We'll keep it in your saved list and bring you straight back here.
gate.messageTitle: Sign in to message the seller
gate.messageBody: We'll bring you back to this animal with your message ready to send.
gate.offerTitle: Sign in to make an offer
gate.offerBody: Offers go to the seller with your account attached.
gate.searchTitle: Sign in to save this search
gate.searchBody: We'll bring you back to these filters so you can name and save the search.
gate.defaultBody: This part of the marketplace needs an account.
gate.sellerBody: You're signed in, but this account can't list animals. Ask an administrator to enable selling, or use your breeder account.

notFound.title: That page isn't here
notFound.body: The listing may have been sold and archived, or the link may be out of date.

genes.none: The seller has not listed genetics. Ask before buying.
genes.labDisagrees: The lab result on the certificate reads “{{result}}”. Ask the seller about this before buying.
genes.labOnly: Found by the lab; not in the seller's description.
genes.legendObserved: Observed: a visual the seller can see.
genes.legendPredicted: Predicted: inferred from the parents, not tested.
genes.title: Genetics, and where each claim comes from
genes.predicted: Predicted from the pairing, not tested
genes.observed: Observed by the seller, not tested

sold.title: Who bought {{title}}?
sold.body: The buyer gets the animal's record in their account: genetics with where each claim comes from, weights, feeding, sheds, health entries, lineage and certificates. Your own copy stays, marked Sold.
sold.confirm: Mark sold and send the record
sold.noThreads: Nobody has messaged you about this animal here, so there is no account to send the record to.
sold.offPlatformNote: The listing is marked sold. No record is transferred, because there is no account to receive it.
sold.done: Sold. {{buyer}} now has the animal and its record.
sold.bodyNoBuyers: Only a buyer with a Serpentora account can receive the animal's record.

acquired.labDisagrees: The seller recorded this, but the certificate reads “{{result}}”.
acquired.noGenetics: No genetics were recorded for this animal.
acquired.emptyBody: When a seller marks an animal sold to you, it arrives here with its record and certificates.
acquired.title: Animals you bought here
acquired.breederAppNote: With a breeder account, the same animals appear in your collection in the Serpentora app after it syncs.
